evidence: PluginInterfaceMethodManifest.required_capabilities is a public Vec and serde keeps input order. For ["zeta", "alpha"], binary_search_by("zeta") returns Err(2), so insertion duplicates zeta. interfaces/exports.rs rejects duplicate method capabilities; no sorted-order validation normalizes them.
impact_or_question: Reusing the builder on a legal unsorted deserialized or manually populated method can turn an existing capability into a duplicate and fail registration.
next_action: Define builder input invariants or normalize external input once; add a later regression for unsorted deserialization followed by repeated capability insertion.

evidence: serde(default) creates an empty feature default_packaging when missing. PluginFeatureBundleManifest::new supplies SourceTemplate/LibraryEmbed, while feature_validation.rs -> default_packaging/presence.rs rejects an empty collection.
impact_or_question: Clarify whether omitted feature packaging should be rejected as incomplete declaration or receive the same defaults as code construction.
next_action: Review static feature TOML expectations and add omission-specific parsing/registration contract evidence before changing defaults.

evidence: CapabilityStatusManifest.target_modes is validated against package coverage; CapabilityView::extend_package_manifest keeps only capability/status and neither filters current target nor retains target_modes.
impact_or_question: Confirm whether projection callers prefilter state rows by target, or target_modes is descriptive only; a target-scoped state can otherwise look global.
next_action: Trace target-specific capability consumers and cover two reports with different target applicability; specify aggregate versus current-target semantics.
